codeReview.summary: Clean, focused fix that correctly addresses the StageType enum YAML serialization bug. save_pipeline() now overrides the stage_type field with stage.stage_type.value (a plain string) before writing with yaml.safe_dump(), and load_pipeline() reconstructs the enum via StageType(stage['stage_type']). The switch from yaml.dump to yaml.safe_dump is a security improvement. UTF-8 encoding is explicitly specified on both read and write paths (good Windows compatibility). The round-trip test is thorough: it creates a multi-stage pipeline with different StageType values, verifies the raw YAML contains string stage types, and asserts full Pipeline equality after load. No regressions — all 23 tests in the suite pass.
